CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION admin_ops.lock_staff_governance()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(77123,1);
 return null;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION admin_ops.require_session(p_actor_id uuid, p_session_id uuid, p_permission text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare r text;
begin
 -- The same native session used by the verified server token must still exist.
 if p_actor_id is null or p_session_id is null
    or not public.triniti_admin_session_check(p_actor_id,p_session_id)
    or not exists(select 1 from auth.sessions where id=p_session_id and user_id=p_actor_id and aal::text in ('aal1','aal2'))
 then raise exception 'ACTIVE_ADMIN_SESSION_REQUIRED' using errcode='42501'; end if;
 perform 1 from auth.sessions s join auth.users u on u.id=s.user_id
 where s.id=p_session_id and s.user_id=p_actor_id and s.aal::text in ('aal1','aal2')
 and (s.not_after is null or s.not_after>now()) and u.deleted_at is null
 and (u.banned_until is null or u.banned_until<=now()) for share of s,u;
 if not found then raise exception 'ACTIVE_ADMIN_SESSION_REQUIRED' using errcode='42501'; end if;
 select role into r from public.admin_users where user_id=p_actor_id and active for share;
 if not coalesce(case p_permission
 when 'verification' then r=any(array['super_admin','platform_admin','verification_reviewer'])
 when 'user_moderate' then r=any(array['super_admin','platform_admin','trust_safety'])
 when 'post_moderate' then r=any(array['super_admin','platform_admin','trust_safety'])
 when 'market_moderate' then r=any(array['super_admin','platform_admin','market_reviewer'])
 when 'report_post' then r=any(array['super_admin','platform_admin','trust_safety'])
 when 'report_listing' then r=any(array['super_admin','platform_admin','trust_safety','market_reviewer'])
 when 'report_user' then r=any(array['super_admin','platform_admin','trust_safety'])
 when 'support' then r=any(array['super_admin','platform_admin','trust_safety','support_agent'])
 when 'ads' then r=any(array['super_admin','platform_admin','market_reviewer','finance_admin'])
 when 'system' then r=any(array['super_admin','platform_admin','ops_engineer'])
 when 'business_manage' then r='super_admin'
 when 'organization_manage' then r='super_admin'
 when 'staff_manage' then r='super_admin'
 when 'account_delete' then r='super_admin'
 when 'comment_delete' then r='super_admin'
 else false end,false) then raise exception 'ADMIN_PERMISSION_DENIED' using errcode='42501'; end if;
 return r;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION admin_ops.retire_single_owner_access()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare affected_owner uuid;
begin
 update admin_ops.single_owner_qa_policy p set enabled=false,updated_at=now()
 where p.enabled and not admin_ops.single_owner_access(p.owner_id)
 returning p.owner_id into affected_owner;
 if affected_owner is not null then
  insert into public.admin_audit_log(admin_id,action,target_kind,target_id,reason,after)
  values(affected_owner,'singleOwnerModeRetired','staff',affected_owner::text,
   'The active staff roster no longer has exactly the configured super administrator.',jsonb_build_object('enabled',false));
 end if;
 return null;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION admin_ops.single_owner_access(p_actor uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select coalesce(exists(
  select 1 from admin_ops.single_owner_qa_policy p
  join public.admin_users a on a.user_id=p.owner_id
  where p.singleton and p.enabled and p.owner_id=p_actor
   and a.active and a.role='super_admin'
   and (select count(*) from public.admin_users where active)=1
 ),false);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION admin_ops.sync_verification_revocation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if old.is_verified and not coalesce(new.is_verified,false) then
  update public.verification_applications set status='revoked',revoked_at=now()
  where applicant_id=new.id and status='approved';
 end if;
 return new;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_support_triage_read(p_ids uuid[])
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
  'ticket_id',t.id,'assigned_to',s.assigned_to,'assigned_name',p.full_name,
  'priority',coalesce(s.priority,'normal'),'queue',coalesce(s.queue,'general'),
  'escalated',coalesce(s.escalated,false),'version',coalesce(s.version,0),
  'support_commands_available',coalesce(has_function_privilege('service_role',to_regprocedure('public.triniti_platinum_admin_command(uuid,uuid,uuid,text,jsonb)'),'EXECUTE'),false),
  'response_due_at',case when t.status='open' and coalesce(m.sender,'user')<>'ops' then
   coalesce(m.created_at,t.created_at)+case coalesce(s.priority,'normal') when 'urgent' then interval '15 minutes' when 'high' then interval '1 hour' when 'low' then interval '72 hours' else interval '24 hours' end end
 )),'[]') from public.support_tickets t
 left join admin_ops.support_triage s on s.ticket_id=t.id
 left join public.profiles p on p.id=s.assigned_to
 left join lateral(select sender,created_at from public.support_messages where ticket_id=t.id order by created_at desc,id desc limit 1) m on true
 where t.id=any(p_ids) and cardinality(p_ids)<=100;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sync_post_comments_count()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  -- Only count top-level comments (not replies)
  update public.posts set comments_count = (
    select count(*) from public.post_comments
    where post_id = coalesce(NEW.post_id, OLD.post_id)
    and parent_comment_id is null
  ) where id = coalesce(NEW.post_id, OLD.post_id);
  return coalesce(NEW, OLD);
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.triniti_admin_session_check(p_user_id uuid, p_session_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM auth.sessions s
    JOIN auth.users u ON u.id = s.user_id
    JOIN public.admin_users a ON a.user_id = s.user_id
    WHERE s.id = p_session_id AND s.user_id = p_user_id
      AND (s.not_after IS NULL OR s.not_after > now())
      AND u.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND (u.banned_until IS NULL OR u.banned_until <= now())
      AND a.active IS TRUE
      AND a.role IN ('super_admin','platform_admin','trust_safety','support_agent','ops_engineer',
                     'market_reviewer','jobs_reviewer','verification_reviewer','finance_admin','analyst','auditor_readonly')
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.triniti_admin_single_owner_access(p_actor_id uuid, p_session_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select coalesce(public.triniti_admin_session_check(p_actor_id,p_session_id),false)
  and admin_ops.single_owner_access(p_actor_id)
  and exists(select 1 from auth.sessions where id=p_session_id and user_id=p_actor_id and aal::text in ('aal1','aal2'));
$function$
